What is in an AV rental package?
The equipment for the event, delivery, setup, technicians on site and strike, on one itemized quote.
Can I change what is in a package?
Yes. Packages are starting points. We add or remove gear to fit the space, the program and the budget.
Why rent a package instead of single items?
One crew plans the sound, light and screens together, so power, cables and cues work as one system and you have one contact on the day.
Do you have an outdoor movie package?
Yes. A projector, a screen, sound and playback, set up before dusk and run by a technician. See outdoor movie rental.
How much does an AV package cost?
It depends on the guest count, the space, the hours and the crew. Send the details and we reply with an itemized quote.
